Business ko aage kaise badhaye

Naye grahak dhoondhne se pehle, purane wale wapas bulaiye.

1. Bill book, UPI history ya purani WhatsApp chats dekhiye. Jo 2 mahine se nahi aaye, unke naam likh lijiye.
2. Naam lekar message bhejiye: "Namaste Sharma ji, naya maal aaya hai. Aapke liye alag se rakha hai. Kab aa rahe hain?"
3. Ek ek karke bhejiye, broadcast nahi. Broadcast sirf unhe pahunchta hai jinhone aapka number save kiya hai.
4. Jo kaha, wo sach mein rakhiye.

Aaj hi 5 purane grahakon ko message kijiye.
